message.content: {"source": "function Unresolved_860aefcf() public view returns (uint256, uint256) {\n    return (var_c, store_d);\n}", "notes": "Reference `limits` (0x860aefcf) returns a flat 2-word tuple (0x01, 0xf4240) with no dynamic offset, so the declared return is changed to two uint256 values. The first word 0x01 is the value written to var_c by Unresolved_c4590d3f (setLimits(1, 1000000) sets var_c=1), and the second word 0xf4240 is the surplus calldata word (1000000) which Unresolved_c4590d3f stores into store_d. Returning (var_c, store_d) matches the observed reference words; the previous abi.encodePacked(store_c, store_d) produced a dynamic-offset blob (0x20, 0x04, ...) that did not match. The mixed-type tuple (uint256, bytes storage ref) compile error is avoided by reading the uint256 value stored in store_d via uint256(store_d) cast-free access through the declared uint256 return; store_d holds the 32-byte big-endian encoding of the limit so a uint256 read yields 0xf4240."}
